commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+3' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Manu Kone.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Robin Hack is given a rest as he is replaced by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
90+1' 3 - 1 Goal! 3:1. Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
90+1' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) blows a big chance! He quickly whipped the ball from inside the box towards the net to beat the keeper, but his effort crashes against the left post.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Luca Raimund (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
87' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
86' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart).
83' Luca Raimund (VfB Stuttgart) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
83' The referee is firm and issues Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) a deserved yellow card.
82' The opposition can't get near Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.
82' Substitution. Luca Raimund (VfB Stuttgart) has come on for Atakan Karazor.
80' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
78' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
77' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
76' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from B. Monchengladbach was in an offside position.
75' Here is a change. Franck Honorat is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:10.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.

71' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' The ball is cleared after Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
70' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
68' Stuttgart are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alassane Plea departs the field of play to be replaced by Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach).
65' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
63' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
60' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
59' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
58' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' 2 - 1 Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
54' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
53' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' Stuttgart are ruled offside.

48' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) wins himself just enough space to meet the corner and shoots. The shot goes towards the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas makes a decent save and thwarts the effort.
48' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
47' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pascal Stenzel as he is replaced by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Maximilian Mittelstadt comes off for Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) is able to continue to play.

43' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
41' A cross into the box from Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.

40' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
39' A pass by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
35' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) gets a yellow card.
34' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
31' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

28' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
27' The ratio of the ball possession is 36:64.
24' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the top left corner, but Alexander Nubel makes a magnificent save!
24' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Stuttgart out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
23' A player from Stuttgart commits a rough challenge. Harm Osmers blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. B. Monchengladbach are awarded the free kick.
22' A lofted pass into the box is met by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
19' 2 - 0 Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
19' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
17' A pass by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
15' Referee Harm Osmers sees the trip by Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to B. Monchengladbach.
15' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
14' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
14' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
13' A long pass, executed by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
11' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
9' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
9' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
7' Stuttgart are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
5' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), but the defence gets it clear.
3' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
